text:
Elaine: Quick sync — AcmeCorp POC reopened vendor security questions. They asked for DPA + SCCs confirmation and how we handle DSARs/data deletion. Can we confirm leads? cc @Omar @Sarah

Omar: I can take SIG/CAIQ answers. Need the latest CAIQ spreadsheet link. Anyone have it?

Mike: I pushed our current CAIQ draft to Confluence: https://redwood.atl/confluence/caiq-acme (work-in-progress). It has SOC2 + encryption+key mgmt details.

Sarah: For DPA/SCCs — legal needs to know whether we act as a subprocessor for the POC. We require a signed DPA. Also need to confirm cross-border transfer controls (SCCs).

Elaine: Customer is asking specifically about log retention for request payloads and PII in logs. What's our default?

Mike: Default: logs scrubbed after 30 days unless customer opts into extended retention for debugging. We redact content matching PII regex. For POC we can offer 0-day retention on Private/Dedicated. /cc @Chris

Chris (Acme): For the POC we actually need 90-day logs for tracing. Is that doable?

Omar: 90 days is doable on Dedicated or Hosted with the "extended retention" add-on (paid). Needs pricing approval. Will map to cost per GB.

Elaine: Note for quote: include extended retention as an optional line item. Also confirm KMS/BYOK capabilities — customer asked about BYOK.

Mike: BYOK/HSM supported in Private. Dedicated supports cloud KMS integrations (customer-managed keys). Encryption at rest + in transit are always on.

Sarah: DSARs: Hosted has a subject-access/deletion API; SLA ~30 days. For Dedicated/Private we provide the runbook and APIs but deletion often executed by the customer infra team — we assist.

Omar: On SIG/CAIQ answers I'll flag multi-tenant shared runtime, VPC/private options, patch cadence, and our CVE response program. Also will document subprocessor list link.

Elaine: Action items: Omar — update CAIQ doc and export a PDF for Acme. Sarah — prepare a 1-paragraph DPA summary for sales to send. Mike — paste exact retention + redaction snippet here.

Mike: snippet to paste into sales blurb:

```
LOG_RETENTION_DAYS=30
PII_REDACTION=true
REDACTION_RULES=regex:(email|ssn|creditcard)
```

I'll confirm with infra tomorrow if we can make regex stricter for the POC.

Sarah: Draft DPA summary for sales:
- We process customer content as a data processor under a DPA.
- We will sign standard EU SCCs for cross-border transfers.
- Subprocessor list is published and updated monthly; customers may request details.
- DSARs & deletions: we provide deletion APIs and support, typical execution SLA 30 days for Hosted.

Elaine: Good — I'll stitch that into the POC scope + quote and ask Legal for sign-off on the DPA. @Chris any blockers from Acme?

Chris (Acme): No blockers. We do need a signed DPA before we ingest any real data. FYI InfoSec will run a short technical questionnaire next week.

Omar: I'll prep the CAIQ export and a short answers sheet. Also recommend we advise Acme to enable tokenization and disable prefix caching for PII-heavy prompts during the POC.

Mike: Agreed — recommend disabling prefix/KV caching for PII workloads. Also will confirm whether we can enable 90-day retention for the POC without extra compliance checks.

Elaine: Thanks all — I'll update the sales doc and ping Legal for DPA signature flow. :thumbsup:
